mentions.name: DealCred
mentions.description: A two-sided deal review site where users can look up and read past reviews of potential deal partners. Built to make due diligence easier for smaller investors in real estate and private money lending. Currently 80% complete, with a beta planned within the next month.
mentions.problem: Due diligence on individuals is difficult; the author experienced bad deals in which over 30 people were scammed and wished there was a simple review site showing someone's past reviews.
mentions.audience: It's aimed at people working with smaller investors, such as those in real estate and private money lending, who need to vet counterparties before deals.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Create a two-sided deal review app: https://dealcred.com

I work a lot with smaller investors, in real estate, private money lending, etc. It's sometimes hard to do due diligence on someone, and after having a couple bad deals and realize over 30 people were scammed, I wished there was a simple review site where you could see someone's past reviews.
